title: Client Status Report
plan:
Stream the body in via update_document with insert ops, one block at a time. Recommended structure:

1. replace the header block: set title to "{Client Name} — Status Report" and subtitle to the date range (e.g. "Mar 31 – Apr 6, 2026").
2. insert a kpis block with 3–4 metrics (Deliverables, On Track, Hours Used, Utilization).
3. insert a text block starting with "## Summary" and one tight paragraph.
4. insert a text block starting with "## This Week" and 3–5 bullets of wins / work delivered.
5. insert a table block with headers ["Task", "Owner", "Status"] and the real rows.
6. insert a text block starting with "## Next Week" and the planned work.
7. If there are blockers: insert a callout block variant="warn" title="Blockers" with the bulleted blockers. If none, skip this block entirely — do not insert an empty callout.
8. insert a footer block.

Never write literal "{{PLACEHOLDER}}" text anywhere. Every field you insert must contain real content gathered from memory, files, or the user's input.
